title: Naturalisation in the interest of the state exists since the 1965 Citizenship Act
description: The Interior Ministry states that § 10(6) StbG (naturalisation in the interest of the state, keeping the previous nationality) has existed as a constitutional provision since the Citizenship Act 1965.
quote: der als Verfassungsbestimmung bereits seit dem Staatsbürgerschafts-gesetz 1965 existiert

title: Tonga begins selling passports (press accounts)
description: CNN dates the sales from 1983, proposed by Hong Kong businessman George Chen; proceeds to the Tonga Trust Fund at Bank of America, San Francisco.
quote: Between 1983 and 1991 over 5,000 were sold raising around $30 million.

title: Citizenship-by-investment program launched
description: St. Kitts and Nevis launched the world's first CBI program, the year after independence.
quote: In 1984, St. Kitts and Nevis launched its Citizenship-by-Investment Program

title: Government approves naturalisation for anyone prepared to invest
description: The review says the Government, in April 1989, approved a large group of applications and decided future applications from investors should also be approved; a Statement of Intent was then given to enquirers.
quote: The Government decided that the applications should be approved and, furthermore, so should future applications for anybody who was prepared to invest in the State.

title: Immigration Act of 1990 creates the EB-5 investor visa
description: Sec. 121 adds INA 203(b)(5) 'Employment creation': up to 10,000 visas a year for investors of USD 1,000,000 (as little as half in targeted employment areas) in a new enterprise creating 10 jobs, with 3,000 visas reserved for targeted employment areas, and two-year conditional residence (INA 216A). The new preference system took effect on 1 Oct 1991 (FY1992).
quote: Visas shall be made available, in a number not to exceed 10,000, to qualified immigrants seek- ing to enter the United States for the purpose of engaging in a new commercial enterprise

title: Law on Citizenship allows exceptional naturalisation for special interest
description: Art. 11 of the 1992 Law on Citizenship allows an adult foreigner to be naturalised without the usual conditions where this is of special scientific, economic, cultural or national interest, with the Government's prior opinion.
quote: претставува посебен научен, економски, културен и на

title: Congress creates the Regional Center (pilot) Program
description: Sec. 610 of the FY1993 Commerce-Justice-State appropriations act sets aside 300 EB-5 visas a year for five years for investors in regional centres, allowing jobs created indirectly to be counted. Later extended many times by appropriations acts.
quote: shall set aside 300 visas annually for five years

title: Citizenship by Investment programme established
description: Dominica’s programme (originally the Economic Citizenship Programme) dates from 1993.
quote: The Commonwealth of Dominica has had a Citizenship by Investment (CBI) Programme since 1993

title: Advisory group terms of reference set a IR£1 million minimum
description: Minister announces Government-approved terms of reference: IR£1m net investment per applicant, Forfás monitoring, police certificates; the scheme to be put on a statutory basis (never done).
quote: the level of investment must involve a net contribution of at least £1 million per applicant

title: Private residential property removed from GIP investments
description: According to a 2005 ministerial statement, private homes had been allowed as a GIP investment but were removed from the list of allowable instruments in 1996. This implies an investor-PR scheme under the GIP name before the 2004 date MTI gives as the programme's inception.
quote: Private residential properties, which had been allowed under the GIP, were removed from the list of allowable investment instruments under the scheme in 1996.

title: Passport sales in the 1990s
description: The IMF records about 300 passports sold in 1996-1997 under 1990s schemes, later damaged by reports of illegal issuance; some countries, such as Canada, dropped visa waivers for Vanuatu nationals.
quote: In the 1990s, there had been attempts to establish passport selling schemes in Vanuatu

title: No new applications accepted pending legislation
description: Government decides to stop accepting new applications until specific legislation is in place; existing applications continue.
quote: On 4 September 1996 the Government decided that no new applications should be accepted pending the introduction of specific legislation

title: Law on Nationality creates investment and donation routes
description: The 1996 Law on Nationality waives the 7-year residence requirement for investors spending 1,250,000,000 riels (Arts 10-11) and lets donors of 1,000,000,000 riels to the national budget apply (Art. 12); grants by Royal Decree; applicants may take a Khmer name.
quote: Promulgated on 09 October 1996

title: Economic Citizenship Program made more attractive by 1997 amendment
description: Industry account: the Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 1997 underpinned an 'economic citizenship' (passport sale) scheme that ran until 2001. No primary document found.
quote: Grenada passed the Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 1997 was passed to make economic citizenship scheme more attractive

title: Nauru creates a "Citizen Investor" category
description: The Nauruan Community Ordinance Amendment Act 1997 lets Cabinet grant citizenship to a person who has made an investment set by Cabinet, on the recommendation of a new Nauru Citizen Investment Board.
location: PDF p. 4 (printed page 3), s. 6 inserting s. 5(6)(f); scanned, quote checked by eye
quote: has made an investment in the island of Nauru of such form and in such amount as determined by Cabinet

title: Minister announces formal end of the scheme
description: Press release: formal ending of the Investment Based Naturalisation Scheme; outstanding cases on hand to be processed under the 1994 procedure.
location: Appendix F, press release dated 20 April 1998
quote: today announced the formal ending of the Investment Based Naturalisation Scheme

title: Department of Justice review published in the Dáil record
description: Minister places the substance of the Feb 1998 review and its statistics in the Official Report. It finds regulation of the scheme 'very difficult' and that it should not be re-established.
quote: The Minister is of the view that the Scheme, as constituted, should not be re-established.

title: US lists jurisdictions actively selling economic citizenship
description: State Department names five Caribbean sellers (Belize, Dominica, Grenada, St Kitts/Nevis, St Vincent and the Grenadines) and Nauru in the Pacific.
quote: Currently five Caribbean Basin OFCs are actively selling economic citizenships: Belize, Dominica, Grenada, St. Kitts/Nevis and St. Vincent and the Grenadines. In the Pacific region, economic citizenships are for sale in Nauru.

title: US says Tonga still sells economic citizenship
description: The State Department's 2000 report says Tonga sells economic citizenship, which contradicts press accounts that sales ended in 1991.
quote: Tonga also sells economic citizenship.

title: US: Nauru sells 'improperly controlled' economic citizenships
description: INCSR 2001 says that in the Pacific, Nauru sells improperly controlled economic citizenships.
quote: In the Pacific region, Nauru sells improperly controlled economic citizenships.

title: St Vincent revokes economic citizenship programme
description: SVG revoked the programme that provided the legal basis to sell citizenship and passports; no passports had been issued.
location: St. Vincent and the Grenadines country section
quote: In April 2001 SVG revoked its economic citizenship program, which provided the legal basis to sell SVG citizenship and passports; however, no passports had been issued.

title: Grenada announces indefinite suspension of the Economic Citizenship Program
description: Foreign Minister Elvin Nimrod told the UN General Assembly that, after checking that no known terrorists had been granted citizenship, the programme was suspended indefinitely. An industry source dates the suspension to October 2001.
location: statement, section on fight against terrorism
quote: the Government of Grenada has taken a decision to suspend indefinitely, the Economic Citizenship Program.

title: Two economic citizens tied to a terrorist group refused US visas
description: US embassy in Belize refused visas to two people who had just bought Belizean economic citizenship; the State Department says they were members of a proscribed Middle Eastern terrorist group.
quote: They were denied entry visas by the consular staff of the American embassy in Belize because the two applicants were members of a proscribed Middle Eastern terrorist group.

title: Canada withdraws visa exemption for Grenada (reported)
description: Reported by an industry source (citing The Globe and Mail) as linked to passports issued under the Economic Citizenship Program. Primary source (Canada Gazette Part II, 19 Dec 2001) identified but not read.
quote: By Dec 2001, Canada revoked visa waiver agreement with Grenada citing security concerns with passports in circulation issued under Economic citizenship program

title: Government admits trust fund money lost
description: Tonga says the Tonga Trust Fund lost 50 million pa'anga through schemes promoted by the King's court jester and that it has started legal action.
quote: In a statement the government said its Tonga Trust Fund had begun legal proceedings to recover the money.

title: Belize marked as not selling economic citizenship (US INCSR 2002 table)
description: The 2002 offshore financial services table marks Belize 'N' in the 'Sells Economic Citizenship' column (2001 table: 'S', suspended or ceased).
quote: Sells Economic Citizenship

title: Belize announces end of economic citizenship sales
description: According to the US State Department, the Government of Belize announced it would cease selling economic citizenships in January 2002. A 2020 academic report also dates the end to 2002.
quote: The government of Belize subsequently announced that it would cease selling economic citizenships in January 2002.

title: Tonga Trust Fund sues Bogdonoff and others in San Francisco
description: Suit for fraud and negligence over the losses in Millennium Asset Management and alleged secret commissions.
quote: the suit filed in San Francisco in June 2002

title: Australia and Brazil challenge EU sugar export subsidies at the WTO
description: Australia and Brazil requested WTO consultations with the European Communities over export subsidies under the EC sugar regime (Council Regulation 1260/2001), opening disputes DS265 and DS266. St Kitts and Nevis was among the ACP sugar exporters that asked to join the consultations.
quote: On 27 September 2002, Australia and Brazil requested consultations with the European Communities concerning the export subsidies provided by the EC in the framework of its Common Organisation of the Market for the sugar sector.

title: Minister finds 11 passports granted in 1990 were 'irregular and unusual'
description: After examining the file (also held by the Moriarty Tribunal), the Minister tells the Dáil that 11 passports and naturalisations were granted bypassing usual formalities; passports were prepared before applications were complete. He also confirms the Review Group report was published in August 2002.
quote: the 11 passports and naturalisations in question were granted in a manner which was, even by the lax standards that have frequently characterised the operation of the scheme in question, irregular and unusual

title: Nauru still marked as selling economic citizenship (INCSR 2003 table)
description: The 2003 offshore financial centers table still marks Nauru 'Y' for selling economic citizenship.
quote: Sells Economic Citizenship

title: Earlier Nauru investor citizenship scheme ends (reported)
description: An academic report says the scheme ran from 1998 and ended in 2003 after international concerns that Nauruan passports were used by suspected terrorists. No official closure document was found.
quote: program ended in 2003 after international concerns about the use of Nauruan passports by suspected terrorists

title: Thailand joins the sugar challenge (DS283)
description: Thailand requested consultations on the same matter, completing the three complainants (Australia, Brazil, Thailand).
quote: On 14 March 2003, Thailand requested consultations with the European Communities on the same matter.

title: St Kitts and Nevis reserves third-party rights in the WTO sugar panel
description: St Kitts and Nevis, then a Sugar Protocol exporter to the EU, reserved third-party rights in the single panel established on 29 August 2003.
quote: On 8 September 2003, Australia, Brazil, St. Kitts and Nevis, Tanzania and Thailand reserved their third-party rights.

title: Global Investor Programme starts (per MTI)
description: MTI and EDB give 2004 as the start of the GIP (run by Contact Singapore, part of EDB). The 2005 statement shows a scheme of that name existed earlier; 2004 may mark a relaunch. Not resolved.
quote: since the programme's inception in 2004

title: Out-of-court settlement
description: Defendants pay about US$0.9-1m up front without admitting liability. Two Tongan ministers had resigned over the affair.
quote: Tonga has settled a long-running lawsuit against its American court jester

title: Art. 11 amended; Government to set criteria by decree
description: The 2004 amendment rewrites Art. 11(1) (adding sport and 'other national interest') and requires the Government to set the criteria by decree.
quote: Владата на Република Македонија со уредба ќе ги

title: WTO panel finds EU sugar export subsidies exceed commitments
description: The panel found that EC sugar exports had exceeded its annual commitment levels since 1995, that exports of C sugar and ACP/India-equivalent sugar received export subsidies, and that the EC acted inconsistently with Articles 3.3 and 8 of the Agreement on Agriculture.
quote: the European Communities' exports of sugar had exceeded its annual commitment levels since 1995, and in particular since the marketing year 2000/2001.

title: Citizenship Act 2004 rules out any future investment scheme
description: Section 10 narrows 'Irish associations' to blood, affinity or adoption links, which the Minister said puts such schemes beyond possibility.
quote: That undertaking has been fulfilled by the provisions of section 10 of the Bill.

title: First decree on criteria for special interest
description: Government decree defines special economic interest broadly (direct investment, donation, securities, shares, know-how, innovation, new technologies) with no minimum amount; assessed by the Ministries of Economy and Finance. In force the day after publication on 9 Feb 2005.
quote: вестирал капитал со:

title: WTO Appellate Body upholds ruling against EU sugar regime
description: The Appellate Body upheld the core findings: footnote 1 of the EC schedule (covering re-exports equivalent to ACP/India preferential imports) did not enlarge EC commitments, and cross-subsidisation of C sugar was a payment on export; the EC exceeded its export subsidy commitments.
quote: The Appellate Body upheld the Panel's finding that the European Communities violated Arts. 3.3 and 8 by exporting C sugar

title: WTO adopts sugar reports
description: The Dispute Settlement Body adopted the Appellate Body report and the panel report as modified.
quote: At its meeting of 19 May 2005, the DSB adopted the Appellate Body report and the Panel report, as modified by the Appellate Body report.

title: Government takes on the sugar company's debt (29% of GDP)
description: According to the IMF, the closure required the government to service the SSMC debt, equal to 29% of GDP, via a 30-year bond mostly held by the state-majority National Bank and secured by about 4,700 acres of land; the industry had lost 3–4% of GDP a year.
quote: The closure has required the government to service the debt of the sugar company (29 percent of GDP).

title: Private homes re-allowed: S$2 million option with up to 50% in residential property
description: Minister for National Development announced a new GIP option: invest at least S$2 million in businesses, funds, foundations or trusts and/or private residential property, with up to half in property, with immediate effect.
quote: This policy change will take immediate effect.

title: St Kitts closes its state sugar industry
description: The St Kitts Sugar Manufacturing Corporation (SSMC) stopped production, ending some 350 years of sugar on St Kitts. The OECS counted 1,406 SSMC employees in July 2005 and put released workers at about 12% of the labour force; the IMF says about 1,400 workers or 6% of the labour force.
quote: On 30 July 2005, the sugar industry in St. Kitts and Nevis was closed resulting in the release of over one thousand workers

title: Arbitrator gives EU until 22 May 2006 to comply on sugar
description: Arbitration under DSU Article 21.3(c) set the reasonable period of time for implementation at 12 months and 3 days.
quote: the arbitrator determined that the reasonable period of time is 12 months and 3 days, expiring on 22 May 2006.

title: SSMC debt folded into central government debt
description: IMF tables include the St Kitts Sugar Manufacturing Company debt in central government debt from 2006.
quote: 8/ St. Kitts Sugar Manufacturing Company (SSMC) debt included in central government debt since 2006.

title: Sugar Industry Diversification Foundation created as a CBI route
description: The SIDF was established in 2006 as an independent foundation funded by CBI contributions to support diversification away from sugar; its income rose from under 1% of GDP in 2007 to an estimated 12% in 2013.
quote: the SIDF was established in 2006 as an independent foundation, funded by contributions from the ECP, to support the development and diversification of the economy away from the sugar industry

title: Sugar Industry Diversification Foundation (SIDF) established
description: SIDF created as an independent foundation funded by CBI contributions after the closure of the sugar industry; became the main donation route.
quote: the SIDF was established in 2006 as an independent foundation, funded by contributions from the ECP

title: EU adopts aid for Sugar Protocol countries hit by reform
description: Regulation (EC) No 266/2006 set up accompanying measures for the 18 Sugar Protocol countries (St Kitts and Nevis included), based on national multiannual adaptation strategies, with EUR 40 million for 2006. St Kitts prepared an "Adaptation Strategy in Response to the New EU Sugar Regime" (IMF CR 07/141, Box 2).
quote: establishing accompanying measures for Sugar Protocol countries affected by the reform of the EU sugar regime

title: EU sugar reform cuts reference prices
description: Council Regulation (EC) No 318/2006 replaced the intervention-price regime with reference prices falling from EUR 631.9/t (white sugar, 2006/07) to EUR 404.4/t from 2009/10, and cited the WTO panel and Appellate Body decisions on export subsidies.
quote: Following the recent decisions on export subsidies of the World Trade Organisation Panel and the Appellate Body on EU export subsidies for sugar

title: EU moves Antigua and St Kitts to the visa-free list (conditional)
description: Regulation 1932/2006 transferred Antigua and Barbuda, the Bahamas, Barbados, Mauritius, St Kitts and Nevis and the Seychelles to the visa-free list, applicable once bilateral visa waiver agreements enter into force.
quote: Antigua and Barbuda, the Bahamas, Barbados, Mauritius, Saint Kitts and Nevis, and the Seychelles should be transferred to Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 539/2001.

title: Cabinet confirms citizenship for two Russian businessmen backed by Haider
description: On the basis of a Council of Ministers decision of January 2007, two Russian-born businessmen were naturalised after Carinthian governor Jörg Haider intervened with the Chancellor. Prosecutors alleged that their payments, EUR 1.9 million in total according to the indictment and largely used to sponsor a Carinthian Formula 1 driver, bought the citizenship; the defendants were acquitted in 2011 and again in 2013.
quote: Auf Basis eines Ministerratsbeschlusses vom Jänner 2007 wurde den beiden Geschäftsleuten die Staatsbürgerschaft verliehen

title: Council of Ministers starts naturalising foreign investors by exception
description: Decision 65.824 introduced the first scheme for naturalising foreign investors and businesspeople, under the 'exceptional services' clause of the Civil Registry Law, with CYP 15m investment or CYP 10m deposit thresholds.
quote: Περίοδος (Α): Αρ. Απόφασης 65.824, ημερ. 11.7.2007

title: EU denounces the ACP Sugar Protocol
description: The Council denounced Protocol 3 on ACP sugar (guaranteed prices and quantities) for 20 ACP states including St Kitts and Nevis, with effect from 1 October 2009, noting the Community "will cease to guarantee prices".
quote: is hereby denounced on behalf of the Community with effect from 1 October 2009 with respect to [...] the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis

title: Tier 1 (Investor) route opens (GBP 1 million)
description: HC 607 replaces the 1994 'investor' category with Tier 1 (Investor) under the Points-Based System from 30 June 2008: GBP 1 million held in the UK, 75% invested, settlement after 5 years.
quote: These changes will come into force on 30th June 2008.

title: Parliament rejects economic citizenship bill
description: In a heated July 2008 session the assembly rejected the bill, calling it an auction of Comorian nationality.
quote: In a heated session of debate in July 2008, the parliament rejected a proposed “economic citizenship” bill

title: Migration regulation sets B/.300,000 'own economic solvency' residence
description: Decreto Ejecutivo 320 of 8 Aug 2008 (Gaceta 26104, 13 Aug 2008) regulates the 2008 migration law; arts. 191-195 set permanent residence for foreigners investing B/.300,000 of foreign funds in property, a fixed deposit, or both. It also sets the B/.160,000 'macro-empresa' investor permit (art. 185).
quote: Podrá solicitar este permiso el extranjero que invierta la suma mínima de trescientos mil balboas (B/.300,000.00)

title: Economic citizenship law signed
description: After a Gulf trip for MPs organised by Comoro Gulf Holding, the bill passed in November 2008 amid a walkout and was signed by President Sambi.
quote: On November 27, 2008, amidst continuing public discontent, the bill was signed into law by President Sambi.

title: Visa-free Schengen access for Antigua and St Kitts begins
description: The EC signed visa waiver agreements with Antigua and Barbuda, the Bahamas, St Kitts and Nevis, Mauritius, Barbados and Seychelles, provisionally applied from signature — the first such agreements the Community concluded.
quote: the agreements are provisionally applied from the date of today's signature, 28 May 2009.

title: Cabinet rejects Carinthia's request to naturalise three Russian hotel investors
description: A week after the Carinthian government approved subsidies for the 'Tibet' hotel project, the Council of Ministers refused the Land's request to naturalise three Russian businessmen planning to invest EUR 6 million; the Interior Minister had vetoed it.
quote: eine Woche später lehnte der Ministerrat den Antrag auf Einbürgerung ab

title: Sugar Protocol guarantees end
description: Date from which the Community's denunciation of the ACP Sugar Protocol took effect.
quote: with effect from 1 October 2009

title: Latvia opens residence permits for investors in property, companies and banks
description: Amendments to the Immigration Law of 22.04.2010 add art. 23(1) points 28-30: five-year temporary residence permits for foreigners investing in company capital, buying property (LVL 100,000 in Riga area / LVL 50,000 elsewhere) or placing LVL 200,000 in bank subordinated capital. Only investments made after 1 July 2010 qualify.
quote: Termiņuzturēšanās atļauju šā likuma 23.panta pirmās daļas 28., 29. un 30.punktā noteiktajā kārtībā ārzemniekam ir tiesības pieprasīt, ja ieguldījums kapitālsabiedrības pamatkapitālā noteiktā apmērā izdarīts, nekustamais īpašums noteiktā vērtībā iegādāts vai finanšu investīcijas noteiktā apmērā izdarītas pēc 2010.gada 1.jūlija.

title: Minimum investment raised to S$2.5 million; property option and parents dropped
description: From 1 Jan 2011 the options became S$2.5 million in a business (A) or a GIP-approved fund (B); partial investment in residential property ended, and parents could no longer be included for PR.
quote: Please note that the following changes in investment options will take effect from 1 January 2011

title: Spouses and dependent children of investors can be naturalised
description: Decision 71.546 extended naturalisation to spouses and financially dependent children over 18 (students up to 28, disabled).
quote: Περίοδος (Β): Αρ. Απόφασης 71.546, ημερ. 4.1.2011

title: Accelerated settlement for GBP 5m and GBP 10m investors
description: HC 863: investors can settle after 3 years with GBP 5m or after 2 years with GBP 10m; absences of up to 180 days a year allowed; first visa extended to 3 years 4 months.
quote: A sum of £10 million or more for two years

title: Stricter property rules and two business tiers
description: Amendments of 26.05.2011 (in force 16.06.2011) require minimum cadastral values (LVL 30,000 / 10,000), restrict who the property may be bought from, and split the business route into LVL 25,000 (small company) and LVL 100,000.
quote: kopējā kadastrālā vērtība to iegādes brīdī ir ne mazāka par 30 000 latu

title: Prosecutors: Russian investors paid twice before naturalisation
description: The anti-corruption prosecutors confirmed that two Russian investors who had since received Austrian citizenship paid a total of USD 2 million and EUR 900,000: the dollars for the Formula 1 career of a Carinthian driver, the second payment apparently for Haider or his party. Haider's former protocol chief was charged with money laundering; the payers and a lawyer were also charged.
quote: zahlten dafür insgesamt zwei Millionen Dollar und 900.000 Euro

title: 'Part of the Game': Carinthian deputy governor Scheuch convicted
description: Uwe Scheuch was convicted for having held out Austrian citizenship to a Russian investor in a recorded 2009 conversation in return for a party donation of 5-10% of the investment; 18 months, six of them unsuspended. The Graz Higher Regional Court later quashed this verdict for a procedural error and ordered a retrial.
quote: Im ersten Prozess war Scheuch am 2. August des Vorjahres zu 18 Monaten Haft, sechs davon unbedingt, verurteilt worden

title: Hong Kong Permanent Residency visa programme launched
description: Residence visas for mainland Chinese investors seeking Hong Kong permanent residency.
quote: residency visa program was launched in September 2011

title: Thresholds cut to EUR 10m investment or EUR 15m deposits; EUR 500,000 home required
description: Decision 72.676 lowered the investment criteria and added a clean-record check and a permanent residence worth over EUR 500,000.
quote: Περίοδος (Α): Αρ. Απόφασης 72.676, ημερ. 10.10.2011

title: IIP rests on a Government decision, not legislation
description: The minister told the Dail in 2022 that the programme was introduced by Government Decision in April 2012, at a time of severe downturn, as part of the Action Plan for Jobs 2012.
quote: The Immigrant Investor Programme (IIP) was introduced by Government Decision in April 2012

title: Ireland opens the Immigrant Investor Programme
description: Approved by Government in January 2012 (announced 24 January) under the Action Plan for Jobs, the IIP opened for applications on 15 April 2012 with four options: EUR 2m bond, EUR 1m enterprise investment, EUR 1m mixed property/bond, EUR 500k endowment. No legislation: it rests on a Government decision and ministerial guidelines.
quote: The programmes will be open for applications from 15 April.

title: Financial Investor Scheme ends
description: The Financial Investor Scheme, a separate investor-PR route (1,080 investors granted PR 2004-2012), ceased.
quote: The FIS has ceased with effect from 15 April 2012.

title: Friendly Nations residence regulated (DE 416), replacing May 2012 decree
description: Decreto Ejecutivo 416 of 13 June 2012 creates permanent residence for nationals of 24 listed countries who carry out an economic or professional activity, and repeals DE 343 of 16 May 2012. Date is the gazette date.
quote: Ejecutivo deroga el "Decreto Ejecutivo No.343 de 16 de

title: Business Innovation and Investment Program replaces Business Skills program; Investor stream at $1.5 million
description: The BIIP (subclass 188 provisional, 888 permanent, 132 Business Talent) was created in 2012 to replace the Business Skills program, with a provisional-to-permanent pathway built around state and territory nomination. The Investor stream required a $1.5 million investment in state/territory bonds.
quote: Investor – $1.5 million for four years, introduced in July 2012

title: Law 29/2012 creates the investment residence permit (ARI)
description: Amendment to the Foreigners Act (Law 23/2007) adds "investment activity" (capital transfer of EUR 1m, 30 jobs, or real estate of EUR 500k, kept for five years) and art. 90-A: residence permit without a residence visa, renewable, with family reunification.
quote: Aquisição de bens imóveis de valor igual ou superior a 500 mil euros

title: First ARI fees set: EUR 5,000 per permit
description: Portaria 305-A/2012 sets EUR 500 for analysis, EUR 5,000 to issue an investor or family permit and EUR 2,500 per renewal, in force 8 Oct 2012; issue and renewal revenue split equally between SEF and the Foreign Ministry's FRI.
quote: A presente portaria entra em vigor no dia 8 de outubro

title: Golden visa (ARI) regime enters into force
description: Law 29/2012 entered into force 60 days after publication; the first two ARI permits were granted in 2012, both for capital transfers.
quote: em vigor desde o dia 8 de outubro de 2012

title: Government says GIP assessment criteria were recently reviewed and tightened
description: Asked about foreigners involved in embezzlement, the Minister of State said the criteria had been reviewed and tightened (notarised documents, bank references, declarations of criminal convictions, screening by other agencies). The Oct 2012 factsheet shows higher turnover thresholds (S$50 million; S$200 million for real estate and construction firms) and requires Option B funds to invest in Singapore-based companies. Exact date of the change not found.
quote: The assessment criteria for applicants under the Global Investor Programme (GIP) was reviewed and tightened recently.

title: Significant Investor visa introduced ($5 million)
description: Significant Investor stream of subclass 188 introduced: $5 million complying investment held for four years, with a light residence requirement and no points test.
quote: Significant Investor – $5 million for four years, introduced in November 2012

title: 'Part of the Game': final verdict against Scheuch
description: The Graz Higher Regional Court upheld the conviction on appeal: seven months suspended and a fine of EUR 67,500 (the Klagenfurt retrial on 6 July 2012 had imposed EUR 150,000).
quote: Scheuch erhielt sieben Monate bedingte Haft und eine deutlich niedrigere Geldstrafe von 67.500 Euro

title: EUR 400,000 investment and 10 jobs threshold introduced
description: Decree amendment of 6 Dec 2012 makes the main economic-interest criterion EUR 400,000 per person of direct investment in new capacity with at least 10 permanent jobs for a year. The European Commission dates the investor scheme to this December 2012 change.
quote: вестирал капитал во износ од најмалку 400.000 евра по

title: Hungary creates residence permits for buyers of special government bonds
description: Act CCXX of 2012 (adopted 11 Dec, promulgated 27 Dec 2012, in force next day) amends Act II of 2007: residence in the 'national economic interest' for holders of at least EUR 250,000 of securities issued by intermediaries approved by Parliament's economic committee (one per country), which buy zero-coupon Hungarian bonds; settlement permit after six months.
quote: Az Országgyűlés gazdasági ügyekért felelős állandó bizottsága országonként csak egy vállalkozást hagyhat jóvá.

title: Sons of Indian tycoon Subrata Roy naturalised
description: In 2013 the sons of Indian businessman Subrata Roy, presented by the then prime minister as major investors on the Ohrid shore, received Macedonian citizenship; Roy was arrested in India shortly after and the investments never materialised, but the family kept the documents.
quote: Летото 2013 година, постариот син на Субрата - Семанто Рој се одомаќини

title: Acquittals in the trial over the 2007 naturalisations of two Russians
description: The Vienna criminal court acquitted Haider's former protocol chief (money laundering) and the two Russian-born businessmen and their lawyer (bribery), finding no proven link between the payments and the grant of citizenship. Not final at the time.
quote: keinen konkreten Konnex zwischen den Zahlungen und der Verleihung der Staatsbürgerschaft

title: SEC freezes assets in Chicago Convention Center EB-5 scheme
description: The SEC charged Anshoo R. Sethi, A Chicago Convention Center and Intercontinental Regional Center Trust of Chicago with selling more than $145 million in securities and collecting $11 million in administrative fees from over 250 mostly Chinese investors for a hotel and convention project, using falsified documents submitted to USCIS. Allegations at filing; an asset freeze preserved most of the money.
quote: fraudulently sold more than $145 million in securities and collected $11 million in administrative fees from more than 250 investors primarily from China

title: Fast-track investor citizenship (art. 14a) added
description: Amendment in State Gazette no. 16 of 19 Feb 2013 creates the fast-track route after one year of permanent residence.
quote: Чл. 14а. (Нов - ДВ, бр. 16 от 2013 г., отм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2022 г.)

title: Bond decree sets EUR 250,000 face value and annual series
description: NGM Decree 4/2013 (19 Feb 2013, in force next day) fixes the bond at EUR 250,000 face value, one series per year, discount pricing, five-year term, sold by ÁKK only to the approved intermediaries without investment firms.

title: Constitutional Court strikes four norms of the new nationality law
description: Ruling 1133/2025 (preventive review requested by 50 MPs) finds unconstitutional the retroactive application to pending cases (art. 7(3)-(4) of Decree 17/XVII) and three other norms, but not the longer residence periods or the end of counting from the permit application.
quote: Pronuncia-se pela inconstitucionalidade da norma extraída dos n.ºs 3 e 4 do artigo 7.º do Decreto n.º 17/XVII

title: US Proclamation restricts entry of Antigua and Barbuda nationals
description: The US Proclamation 'Restricting and Limiting the Entry of Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States' (16 Dec 2025) covered Antigua and Barbuda. The ambassador said visas already issued stay valid and new applications would face new biometric arrangements.
quote: following the issuance of the United States Proclamation entitled “Restricting and Limiting the Entry of Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States,” issued on 16 December 2025

title: US partially restricts entry of Antigua and Barbuda nationals over CBI
description: Proclamation 10998 suspended entry as immigrants and on B, F, M and J visas, effective 1 January 2026.
quote: (i) Antigua and Barbuda has historically had CBI without residency.

title: US partially restricts entry of Dominica nationals over CBI
description: Proclamation 10998 suspended entry as immigrants and on B, F, M and J visas, effective 1 January 2026.
quote: (i) Dominica has historically had CBI without residency.

title: Budget: CBI shortfall drives revenue miss
description: 2026 budget address: non-tax revenue 48.3% below budget due to a CBI slowdown (figures match 2024), and 2025 revenue projected ~31.3% below budget largely because of CBI receipts.
quote: approximately 31.3 percent largely attributable to the shortfall in receipts from the CBI Programme.

title: Not included in US partial visa restrictions
description: The US proclamation of 16 Dec 2025 imposed partial restrictions on Antigua and Barbuda and Dominica, citing CBI; Saint Lucia is not on the list.
quote: Angola, Antigua and Barbuda, Benin, Burundi, Cote d 'Ivoire, Cuba, Dominica, Gabon

title: MICI launches online platform for qualified-investor certificates
description: MICI presents a digital platform for filing qualified-investor applications; DE 17 of 2026 later makes the platform the filing channel for certificates.
quote: MICI presenta nueva plataforma para inversionistas calificados

title: US partially suspends entry of Dominica nationals from 1 January 2026
description: Presidential proclamation includes Dominica and Antigua and Barbuda explicitly because of their CBI programmes.
quote: the December one includes countries (i.e., Antigua and Barbuda and Dominica) on the basis of their offering citizenship by investment programs

title: EU Commission: CBI schemes a potential ground for suspending visa-free travel
description: Eighth Visa Suspension Mechanism report names Grenada among five Eastern Caribbean countries; notes steps taken incl. harmonised US$200,000 minimum but continuing 'significant concern'.
quote: constitutes a potential ground for the suspension of visa-free travel under the revised Visa Suspension Mechanism.

title: EU warns Caribbean CBI could trigger visa suspension
description: Eighth VSM report: about 107,000 passports issued by the five states; CBI is a potential ground for suspension under the revised mechanism; states should vet applicants "pending the discontinuation of those schemes".
quote: constitutes a potential ground for the suspension of visa-free travel under the revised Visa Suspension Mechanism.

title: Commission: North Macedonia must abolish the investor citizenship scheme
description: Under the revised Visa Suspension Mechanism, where operating such schemes is in itself a ground for suspending visa-free travel, the Eighth VSM report says North Macedonia must abolish the scheme and repeal its legal basis.
quote: North Macedonia must abolish the scheme and repeal its legal

title: Commission: investor citizenship is now a ground to suspend visa-free travel; Montenegro must repeal the legal basis
description: Eighth visa-suspension report: under the revised mechanism, running such a programme is in itself a ground for suspension; Montenegro must repeal the legal basis, process the remaining files securely and revoke citizenship of sanctioned persons.
quote: Montenegro must ensure that the legal basis of the scheme is repealed

title: Antigua and Barbuda included in US Visa Bond Pilot Program
description: Government statement confirms inclusion in the US visa-bond pilot for a narrow category of new visitor-visa applicants.
quote: while Antigua and Barbuda has been included in a U.S. Visa Bond Pilot Program

title: OCCRP: 'cash for citizenship' underpinned crime groups' penetration of Cambodia
description: OCCRP reports that several China-born figures who obtained Cambodian citizenship were later sanctioned or prosecuted (Prince Group's Chen Zhi, extradited to China; Dong Lecheng; She Zhijiang), and that nine of the ten people convicted in Singapore's 2023 laundering case had acquired Cambodian citizenship.
quote: citizenship scheme has underpinned the penetration of crime groups into the country

title: Administrative Court of Appeal refers 'acts of government' question to the Supreme Constitutional Court
description: Appeals by applicants against refusals, non-acceptance, revocations and the abolition itself; the Republic argues CIP naturalisations are not subject to judicial review.
quote: Δεκτό έκανε το Διοικητικό Εφετείο το αίτημα του Γενικού Εισαγγελέα

title: Prices restructured: USD 115,000 contribution, lower fees
description: Amendment Regulations 2026 replace family-size tiers with a USD 115,000 single-applicant contribution plus per-dependant amounts, cut the application fee to 5,000 and due diligence to 6,000, and add a USD 10,000 administration fee.
quote: Schedule 1 is deleted and substituted as follows

title: Temporary discount to USD 90,000 ("Iruwa Initiative")
description: Cabinet designated a special project marking the first anniversary, cutting the main-applicant contribution to USD 90,000 from 29 Jan to 30 Jun 2026.
quote: The contribution value for the special project is reduced from $115,000 USD to $90,000 USD for the main applicant

title: Last day for Tier 1 (Investor) extension applications
description: Under CP 632, extension (and re-entry) applications had to be made before 17 Feb 2026; settlement applications must be made before 17 Feb 2028.
quote: “(h) The application must be made before 17th February 2026.”.

title: FinCEN rescinds its 2014 St Kitts advisory
description: According to the St Kitts and Nevis Citizenship Unit, FinCEN formally removed advisory FIN-2014-A004 on 24 February 2026.
quote: The advisory, which had been in place since 2014, was formally removed on 24 February 2026

title: FinCEN advisory rescinded
description: The CIU says FinCEN formally removed advisory FIN-2014-A004 on 24 February 2026.
quote: The advisory, which had been in place since 2014, was formally removed on 24 February 2026

title: Congress sets tax residence rules for investment citizens
description: Ley 27802, art. 194: people naturalised for a relevant investment do not become tax residents merely by naturalisation. First law passed by Congress that refers to the scheme.
quote: no serán consideradas residentes fiscales en los términos del inciso a) del presente artículo por el solo hecho de dicha naturalización

title: European Commission closes the infringement procedure against Cyprus
description: After the inquiry, revocations and the law removing the investor-naturalisation power.
quote: it has decided to close the infringement procedure initiated against the Republic of Cyprus

title: Eight project owners in legal proceedings over refused proposals
description: Three years after closure, 1,192 investor applications were still pending and 8 project owners had gone to court over unsuccessful proposals. Date is that of the Dail answer.
quote: 8 project owners have taken legal proceedings in relation to proposals that were unsuccessful

title: Built real estate option at US$500,000
description: SI 57 of 2026 adds approved built real estate (apartments, villas) at US$500,000 and renames marketing agents business advisory partners.
quote: Applicant and            US$500,000

title: First executive director of the citizenship-by-investment agency appointed
description: Decreto 285/2026 appoints the Agency's executive director, ad honorem, from 22 April 2026. No Ministry of Economy rule defining relevant investments had been published by 1 Oct 2026.
quote: con carácter “ad honorem” en el cargo de Directora Ejecutiva de la AGENCIA DE PROGRAMAS DE CIUDADANÍA POR INVERSIÓN

title: Regional CBI regulator agreement enacted into law
description: The IMF reports that an agreement setting up an independent regional regulator for CIPs has been enacted into law in Antigua and Barbuda and other ECCU CBI states (date of enactment not given; reported by May 2026).
quote: an agreement establishing an independent regulator for the industry has been enacted into law in Antigua and Barbuda

title: Naturalisation now needs 10 years of residence for most golden-visa holders
description: Organic Law 1/2026 requires 7 years of legal residence for CPLP and EU nationals and 10 years for others, revokes counting from the permit application date (art. 15(4)), and keeps the old law for procedures pending on entry into force (19 May 2026).
quote: ou 10 anos, no caso de nacionais de outros países

title: State-securities route deleted
description: Point 31 (interest-free state securities) deleted from art. 23(1) by the law of 23.04.2026, in force 20.05.2026.
quote: 31) (izslēgts ar 23.04.2026. likumu);

title: Interior Minister gives updated total: 174,567 people since 2018
description: Minister Mustafa Çiftçi: 51,762 investors and 122,805 family members naturalised; USD 16.074bn of investment.
location: section '174 bin kişiye yatırım karşılığı vatandaşlık'
quote: toplam 174 bin 567 kişi bu kapsamda Türk vatandaşlığı kazanmıştır

title: Draft law to remove fixed investment amounts
description: The Interior Ministry published draft amendments to the Law on Citizenship on ENER, citing the Commission: fixed investment amounts would be removed and each case assessed individually on the opinion of competent institutions, with investment no longer automatically giving the right. Adoption not confirmed as of 2026-10-02.
location: section 'Што се менува за странските инвеститори?'
quote: Со законските измени се укинуваат фиксните парични износи за стекнување државјанство

title: USD 90,000 discount extended to end-2026
description: Cabinet Resolution 539/2026 extends the Iruwa Initiative to 31 Dec 2026.
quote: extends the duration of the Special Project for the ‘The Iruwa Initiative’ to 31 December 2026

title: European Commission asks CBI states to phase out programmes by 1 June 2028
description: Letter from Commissioner Magnus Brunner (reported via the Antigua and Barbuda PM’s office) requests phase-out with a 24-month transition; the five states rejected the demand.
quote: The five Eastern Caribbean states with active Citizenship by Investment (CBI) Programmes, have been given until June 1, 2028 to phase out their programmes.

title: PM says EU could withdraw visa-free access by end of 2026
description: PM Browne said the EU had threatened to withdraw visa-free access, possibly by year end, and that the CIP would continue anyway.
quote: has threatened that they could withdraw their visa-free access potentially by the end of the year

title: DHS proposes EB-5 integrity regulations (proposed)
description: Proposed rule implementing the 2022 Act's integrity provisions (regional center and project applications, audits, sanctions, automatic revocation of petitions, priority-date retention, bridge financing); comments closed 31 Aug 2026. Not final as of 2 Oct 2026.
quote: This proposed rule would implement the EB–5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022 (RIA)

title: Istanbul operation on fake valuation reports (first wave)
description: Operation in 16 provinces against 90 suspects (72 detained) over sham sales of low-value property backed by inflated valuation reports; 687 people found to have obtained citizenship irregularly (Babacan İnşaat-linked sales).
quote: Bu yolla 687 kişinin usulsüz vatandaşlık kazandığı açıklandı.

title: Ministry announces 6,134 CBI citizenships annulled or withdrawn
description: Interior Ministry: 1,150 investors' investment certificates cancelled after fake/irregular valuation reports (5,391 persons' citizenship annulled) and 263 investors (743 persons) withdrawn on security grounds.
quote: toplamda 1413 yatırımcı ve aile fertleri ile birlikte 6 bin 134 kişinin vatandaşlık kazanma kararı

title: Saeima adopts new Immigration Law
description: The Saeima adopted a new Immigration Law on 20 Aug 2026 (published 1 Sep 2026, in force 15 Sep 2026), replacing the 2002 law.
quote: Likums Saeimā pieņemts 2026. gada 20. augustā.

title: Property and bank routes end; business permits cut to two years; new fund route
description: The new Immigration Law no longer provides residence permits for property buyers or for investors in bank subordinated liabilities. Business-investment permits continue for up to two years; a EUR 150,000 route via a state-created alternative investment fund manager is created but not yet usable because the fund does not exist. Existing holders can renew under transitional rules (points 10-11).
quote: Vienlaikus likums vairs neparedz termiņuzturēšanās atļauju piešķiršanas iespēju nekustamā īpašuma pircējiem vai ieguldītājiem kredītiestāžu pakārtotajās saistībās.

title: New Qualified Investor decree: B/.500,000 for resale property, B/.500,000 deposits at state banks (DE 17)
description: Decreto Ejecutivo 17 of 8 Sept 2026 (Gaceta 30613, 16 Sept 2026) replaces DE 722 and its amendments: B/.300,000 for new first-sale property, B/.500,000 for resale property, B/.500,000 deposits at Banco Nacional or Caja de Ahorros (B/.750,000 elsewhere), wider securities options, valuation checks, a three-year cap on presale-only status, and naturalisation after five consecutive years. Applications filed, and investments contracted, before entry into force keep the old rules if filed within six months.
quote: No. 722 de 15 de octubre de 2020, modificado por los Decretos Ejecutivos No. 109 de 13 de octubre de 2022 y No. 193 de 15 de octubre de 2024.

title: Qualified investors and dependants may naturalise after five consecutive years
description: Article 14 of DE 17 of 2026 states that qualified-investor residents and their dependants may apply for Panamanian nationality by naturalisation after five consecutive years of residence, as the Constitution provides, filed through MICI's window.
quote: una vez hayan cumplido cinco (5) años consecutivos de residencia en la República de Panamá, conforme a lo dispuesto en la Constitución Política

title: Second wave: 274 sham sales, 1,070 irregular citizenships
description: Istanbul prosecutors: 274 of 734 sales to foreigners by three construction firms were sham; 1,070 persons naturalised irregularly; USD 72.25m of required FX never entered; 88 suspects, 72 detained, 2,011 properties frozen, 30 companies placed under trustees.
quote: 274 satış işleminin muvazaalı olduğu tespit edilmiştir

title: AIMA reports record 2,685 golden visas in 2025
description: AIMA's 2025 migration report shows 2,685 ARI permits and 3,967 family permits in 2025, led by US, Chinese and British nationals; it no longer reports investment amounts.
quote: foram concedidas 2.685 autorizações durante o ano de 2025

title: Cut-off date for protection of regional-center petitions if the program lapses
description: Under INA 203(b)(5)(S), added by sec. 108 of the 2022 Act, regional-center petitions filed on or before 30 Sep 2026 must continue to be processed and cannot be denied because the program expires (authorisation ends 30 Sep 2027).
quote: regional center that were filed on or before September 30, 2026

title: Final EB-5 fee rule: new fees from 30 Nov 2026
description: I-526 USD 7,615, I-526E USD 7,850, I-829 USD 5,000, I-956 USD 44,115; Integrity Fund fees up 10% (USD 22,000 / 11,000 per regional center, USD 1,100 per I-526E). Effective 30 Nov 2026.
quote: This final rule is effective November 30, 2026.

title: 'Trump Platinum Card' advertised as 'Coming Soon' (announced, not established)
description: trumpcard.gov invites foreign nationals to join a waitlist for a USD 5 million 'Trump Platinum Card' allowing up to 270 days a year in the US without US tax on non-US income. No executive order, regulation or law creating it was found; the tax treatment would need a legal basis. Date is when the page was seen, not when the announcement was first made.
quote: The Trump Platinum Card has not yet been released.
